subject: Fincobank - audit logs / data access follow-up
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fincobank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fincobank - audit logs / data access follow-up

Hi Alex 

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps around audit logs and data access so we're aligned: 

Summary of your asks
- Proof of who accessed what/when for customer resources (per-principal access logs)
- Exportable audit logs (CSV/JSON) and schema for ingestion into your SIEM
- Retention policy options and ability to export/retain beyond Redwood defaults
- Data residency confirmation (US-only) and handling of PII (redaction/pseudonymization)

What we can provide next
- Sample export (schema + sample rows) and a screenshot of the access console for your security team
- Clarify default retention (90 days) and options we offer for long-term retention or managed export as a store-and-forward deliverable
- Confirmation on data residency  we can serve and store logs in a US region for your account
- Notes on PII handling  we have field-level controls and can redact or pseudonymize identifiable fields on export; we'll outline specifics in the sample schema

Next steps
1) I'll loop in Marissa and Ben to provide the sample schema and an initial pass at how "who/what/when" is represented in our logs.
2) If that looks good, let's schedule a short technical call with your security engineer to walk through the export and retention options. Can you share availability for a 30-min slot next week?

Thanks  talk soon.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachment: none in this message

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fincobank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Team <security@fincobank.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fincobank - audit logs / data access follow-up

Thanks Jordan 

Appreciate the recap. A few additional details from our side to help Marissa and the team scope the evidence request: 

Must-haves for our audit:
- Per-principal access events including: principal_id, principal_type (user/service), action, resource_id, resource_type, timestamp (UTC), source_ip, and request_id
- Ability to filter exports by time range and by resource/customer-id
- Export formats: CSV preferred, JSON acceptable (schema required)
- Retention expectation: for flagged (PII) data we need the ability to retain evidence for up to 7 years; for standard audit events we expect 3 years. If you have a managed archival/export option we need details on process and SLAs
- Data residency: must be stored and exported from US-only infrastructure for this project
- PII handling: indicate which fields are stored in cleartext vs hashed/pseudonymized and whether redaction can be applied on export

Can you provide a sample export (1k rows) and the schema by EOD Wednesday? Also please include any existing compliance artifacts (SOC2 report or mapping) that speak to the control environment around access logging.

If a quick tech call helps, our security lead Ali is available 2026-08-20 after 10am PT.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Senior Security PM | FincoBank
alex.rivera@fincobank.com

Attachment: FincoBank_security_questionnaire.pdf (attached separately)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fincobank.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fincobank - audit logs / data access follow-up

Hi Alex 

Thanks for the detailed list  noted and we can deliver on each of those points. High-level answers and attached artifacts below.

Short answers
- Fields: our access log export includes principal_id, principal_type, action, resource_id, resource_type, timestamp_utc, source_ip, request_id, user_agent, and session_id.
- Filtering/exports: exports can be filtered by time range and resource/customer id; we support scheduled exports and ad-hoc downloads via the Console or API.
- Formats: CSV and JSON both supported; schema attached (audit_log_schema.csv) with sample rows in the first tab/sample.
- Retention: default retained in hot storage for 90 days. We offer managed archival to long-term storage (S3-compatible bucket in US region) as an add-on with export+retention SLAs; we can retain up to 7 years per contract for flagged datasets.
- Data residency: we can pin the account to our US region; logs and exports will be served from that region.
- PII handling: by default logs include principal identifiers (internal id) and resource ids. We support redaction/pseudonymization at export time  configurable fields are documented in the schema.

Attachments included
- audit_log_schema.csv (CSV schema + sample rows)
- access_console_screenshot.png (console view showing access events)

Actions we propose
1) I'll drop the sample export (1k rows) into the shared Drive link and confirm its location by EOD.
2) Jordan  can you schedule a 30-min technical call with Alex and Ali on 2026-08-20 at 10:30am PT? That slot should work for our infra lead Ben.
3) We'll prepare a brief mapping to SOC2 controls and provide the relevant report excerpt for your review (we can redact sensitive details).

If you need anything faster, ping me here.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: audit_log_schema.csv; access_console_screenshot.png

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fincobank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Security Team <security@fincobank.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fincobank - audit logs / data access follow-up

Marissa 

Thanks, this is helpful. We'll review the schema and sample export once you upload to the drive link. A few items we'll need after that review: 
- Formal evidence tying logging controls to your SOC2 (or equivalent) report and any attestation you can provide for the logging/control design
- Signed statement that exports for this account will be produced from US-only infrastructure
- A technical contact for the archival export workflow and SLA (Ben looks like the right person)

Ali (cc'd)  we'll plan to join the 10:30am PT call tomorrow. Please confirm.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Alex

Attachment: FincoBank_security_questionnaire_filled.pdf (will upload once reviewed)
